STATIC_MEANS_CONSTANT.remediation_suggestion:
Pedagogical Intervention:
  `static int count = 0; count++;` compiles and runs. Static means shared across all instances, not immutable. `final` (Java) or `const` (C++) makes something immutable.
Key Takeaway: `static int count = 0; count++;` compiles and runs. Static means shared across all instances, not immutable. `final` (Java) or `const` (C++) makes something immutable.
